name: a11y-audit-toolkit
description: Multi-engine WCAG 2.2 Level AA accessibility audit toolkit — coordinates axe-core, Pa11y, Lighthouse, and IBM Equal Access with a 7-phase manual methodology

scripts.test: node test/shared.test.mjs && node test/merge.test.mjs && node test/diff.test.mjs && node test/integration.test.mjs
scripts.test:unit: node test/shared.test.mjs && node test/merge.test.mjs && node test/diff.test.mjs
scripts.syntax-check: for f in audit-*.mjs lib/shared.mjs test/*.mjs; do node --check $f || exit 1; done; echo OK
